{{Short description|Dutch mathematician and psychologist (born 1943)}}
'''Jan Johan Koenderink''' (born 10 February 1943, [[Stramproy]]<ref>{{Cite book|title = Perceiving in Depth, Volume 3: Other Mechanisms of Depth Perception|url = https://books.google.com/books?id=3m2JAgAAQBAJ&pg=PA51|publisher = Oxford University Press|date = 2012|isbn = 9780199877362|language = en|first = Ian P.|last = Howard|page = 51}}</ref>) is a Dutch [[physicist]] and [[psychologist]] known for his research in [[visual perception]], [[computer vision]], and [[geometry]].

Koenderink earned a bachelor's degree from  [[Utrecht University]] in 1964, a master's in 1967, and a Ph.D. in 1972 on a thesis titled ''Models of the visual system''.
He was a full professor of physics and astronomy at Utrecht University from 1978 until his [[mandatory retirement]] in 2008; since then, he has held fellow or visiting professor positions at Utrecht, the [[Delft University of Technology]], the [[Massachusetts Institute of Technology]], and [[Katholieke Universiteit Leuven]].<ref name="cv">{{citation|title=Curriculum Vitae of Jan Koenderink|url=http://hostweb3.ammin.uniss.it/documenti/curriculum_KOENDERINK_1401213333.pdf|date=May 2014|accessdate=2015-11-28}}</ref>

Koenderink is the author of the books ''Color for the Sciences'' (MIT Press, 2010), on [[colorimetry]],<ref>{{citation
 | last = Centore | first = Paul
 | date = September 2012
 | department = Book review
 | doi = 10.1002/col.21774
 | issue = 6
 | journal = Color Research & Application
 | pages = 428–454
 | title = Color for the Sciences
 | volume = 37}}.</ref> and ''Solid Shape'' (MIT Press, 1990), on [[differential geometry]].<ref>{{citation
 | last = Lange | first = Les
 | date = May 1993
 | department = Review
 | doi = 10.2307/2686494
 | issue = 3
 | journal = The College Mathematics Journal
 | page = 282
 | title = Solid Shape
 | volume = 24| jstor = 2686494
 }}.</ref><ref>Review of ''Solid Shape'' by Wolfgang Boehm (1991), {{MR|1045203}}.</ref>

In 1987, the Katholieke Universiteit Leuven awarded Koenderink an honorary doctorate.<ref name="cv"/>

Koenderink became a fellow of the [[Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences]] in 1990,<ref>{{citation|url=https://www.knaw.nl/nl/leden/leden/4381|title=Member profile: Jan Koenderink|publisher=[[Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences]]|accessdate=2015-11-28|archive-date=2015-12-08|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151208132511/https://www.knaw.nl/nl/leden/leden/4381|url-status=dead}}.</ref> and of the [[Royal Flemish Academy of Belgium for Science and the Arts]] in 2010.<ref name="cv"/>

Koenderink is the 2013 recipient of the [[Azriel Rosenfeld Award]] for lifetime achievement in computer vision.<ref>{{citation|url=http://www.computer.org/web/tcpami/azriel-rosenfeld-lifetime-achievement-award;jsessionid=79912fadae9d56e6595fd7838bd6|title=PAMI Azriel Rosenfeld Lifetime Achievement Award|publisher=[[IEEE Computer Society]]|accessdate=2015-11-28|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151208152118/http://www.computer.org/web/tcpami/azriel-rosenfeld-lifetime-achievement-award;jsessionid=79912fadae9d56e6595fd7838bd6|archive-date=2015-12-08|url-status=dead}}.</ref>

In 2017, Koenderink, along with Andrea Van Doorn, was awarded the [[Kurt Koffka Medal|Kurt-Koffka medal]] from [[Justus Liebig University Giessen]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.uni-giessen.de/fbz/fb06/psychologie/postertag-koffka/KKM/preisverleihung_2017|title = Preisverleihung 2017}}</ref>
